title: Priority-aware local aggregator for console metrics
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce a lightweight, priority-aware local aggregation layer that sits at the ingestion edge of the Console telemetry pipeline. The component will co-locate with ingress workers to perform short-window aggregation and priority-preserving sampling so downstream stream processors see fewer records while latency-sensitive SLOs are preserved. The aggregator must be tenant-aware, bounded in memory, and configurable per-route (e.g., high-priority traces vs low-priority usage counters). The goal is to reduce downstream queue pressure during spikes, improve end-to-end p95 for live dashboards, and lower egress costs without losing high-value signals.
acceptance_criteria: Edge aggregation can be toggled per-route via feature flag and config in the Console routing table
Measured reduction of downstream events >= 65% for low-priority buckets in synthetic spike tests
End-to-end p95 for dashboard queries improves by at least 20ms in the baseline cluster under load
No lost high-priority events: 99.99% delivery guarantee for priority 'P0' events under normal operations
Memory usage per ingress worker bounded and configured with an LRU eviction policy and soft limits
Automated e2e test and a load test harness added to perf repo with reproducible results
implementation_notes: Design a two-tier strategy: (1) per-tenant delta/rollup aggregation for counters and gauges with time windows (e.g., 5s, 30s), (2) priority-reservoir sampling for high-cardinality events
Use in-process ring buffer for sub-100ms windows; fallback to a local embedded RocksDB when memory hit thresholds to avoid OOMs
Maintain a lightweight ack log with sequence watermarks to avoid duplicates when upstream retries occur; integrate with existing ingest-lease mechanism
Expose telemetry on aggregator effectiveness (events_in, events_out, drop_rate_by_priority, memory_pressure) to console-obs for alerting
Config schema: route-level config with fields {enabled, window_ms, priority_cutoffs, reservoir_size, memory_limit_mb, passthrough_threshold} stored in central config service
Failure modes: when overloaded, switch to passthrough for high-priority events and probabilistic sampling for low-priority; ensure timeout on aggregation to avoid adding tail latency
Security: respect tenant isolation; aggregator must never combine payloads across tenants or leak sensitive metadata
